name: y4bo personal picks
description: The built-in port shelf: a few personal picks, not a recommendation list. Add any other GitHub or GitLab repo yourself. Hand-edited; format: catalog/README.md.

apps.name: Project Midas
apps.description: Work-in-progress PC port of GoldenEye 007 from the N64 decompilation. Bring your own US cart image and put it in the Data folder next to ProjectMidas.exe. The release is a .7z, so 7-Zip needs to be installed.

apps.name: Perfect Dark
apps.description: PC port from the N64 decompilation. Bring your own Perfect Dark ROM and put it in the data folder.

apps.name: Star Fox 64
apps.description: N64 recompilation. Bring your own Star Fox 64 (USA) ROM; the game asks for it on first run.
